planner: released JEPA-WM CEM configuration, H6, 300 candidates, 15 iterations, execute 3 model actions per replan

operator_development_replay.allowed_use: offline geometry transfer, planner replay, snapshot forks, and operator/dose selection

held_closed_loop_evaluation.allowed_use: precomputed unsteered arm and later paired sham/steered closed-loop evaluation
held_closed_loop_evaluation.restriction: do not tune layer, subspace, operator, or dose from these outcomes

primary_behavioral_endpoint: final-step simulator success, matching the released evaluator
secondary_behavioral_endpoints: final state distance to expert goal
preprocessing_contract: raw visual and proprioceptive observations at every replan
planner RNG state immediately before CEM planning
chosen normalized and raw plans plus planner losses
MuJoCo qpos/qvel and MetaWorld task state for snapshot restoration
